records.evidence: VERIFIED live: manifest provenance.source.release v3.1.0 vs workbenchVersion v3.1.3 is reported as unverified-provenance, exactly the distinction this states.

records.title: Verify runtime integrity from inside the installed room
records.decision: An installed room can compare its managed runtime with its receipt using local installed capabilities, distinguishing authentic runtime with stale receipt, modified runtime and unavailable source comparison.
records.why: Verification depended on a neighboring source checkout and different defects were collapsed into one drift message.
records.evidence: S-039 installed-runtime-integrity complete.

records.title: Presence-only migration must not acquire replacement effects
records.decision: A layout-only route may recognize an existing linked skill and skip it, but cannot install, mark, back up or replace it; explicit update alone may replace supported managed content.
records.why: A harmless presence check inherited destructive-update restrictions and blocked legitimate migration.
records.evidence: S-045 TK-001 is the live open instance of this exact presence-vs-replacement disagreement.

records.title: Repair installed state explicitly without reinstalling or rewriting content
records.decision: Track seeded document generations, provide explicit repair/normalization for owned metadata and preserve bodies; validation itself remains read-only.
records.why: Upstream fixes did not reach existing rooms, and read-only checks risked hiding mutations.
records.evidence: S-042 installed-state-repair complete.

records.title: Line endings are portable record syntax, not semantic state
records.decision: LF, CRLF and CR frontmatter parse equivalently; reading/validation does not rewrite the file, and an editing operation preserves the room's terminator where specified.
records.why: A Windows checkout made valid ADR and Wiki records fail on syntax that macOS fixtures never exercised.
records.evidence: S-037 complete with tests; the invariant binds every future record parser and has no ADR.

records.title: Diagnostics must communicate consequence, not just severity
records.decision: Make blocking findings visibly distinct from informational findings and retain the registered effects unchanged.
records.why: A valid room looked failed when nonblocking information had the same prominence as a true stop.
records.evidence: VERIFIED: doctor prints 'informational (33) - reported only; nothing is blocked' and each line names its effect.

records.title: Classify legacy rooms read-only and expose all setup gaps together
records.decision: Identify genesis, adoption, upgrade or unclassifiable from evidence without mutation; report all missing/unfilled controls and the reconcile-before-migrate order.
records.why: First-error-only refusal produced repeated stops and encouraged copying templates over project-owned rules.
records.evidence: S-044 legacy-room-classification complete.

records.title: Open follow-ups must remain reachable outside completed specs
records.decision: Unfinished findings need a reachable current owner with truthful blocked/ready state; a completed spec that ordinary entry skips cannot be their only home.
records.why: Several acknowledged problems disappeared from the route arriving agents were instructed to follow.
records.evidence: VERIFIED: S-045 exists precisely because seven follow-ups survived only as prose in completed specs; six are still blocked on owner direction.

records.title: Tests should pin the intended invariant, not incidental global state
records.decision: Verify relevant identities, relationships and actual behavior rather than freezing a global allocator counter or making the test repeat the implementation's mistaken assumptions.
records.why: An unrelated identity allocation broke a focused Canon test, and a permission test reinforced the same false model as the implementation.
records.evidence: AGENTS mandates red/green TDD; the 'pin the invariant, not incidental global state' lesson has no owner.

records.title: Finish file-changing work with verified, recoverable, reviewable state
records.decision: The owner wanted agents to handle branch safety, verification, relevant documentation, commit, push and review preparation as part of finishing file-changing work, leaving the owner to approve the meaningful result.
records.why: Repeated manual requests to save and prepare review meant the harness was not completing its own workflow.
records.state: Accepted historical direction; later scope narrowed
records.evidence: AGENTS Branch Completion carries the end-to-end expectation; ADR-0034/0037 narrow the early every-message formulation.

candidates.title: The perpetual handoff is the acceptance boundary
candidates.question: What test decides whether the Workbench works: that its files exist, or that a fresh agent resumes useful work from them?
candidates.existing: Extends ADR-0035 (reduced entry) and ADR-0040 (JSON notepads); neither states the outcome those mechanisms serve.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR. State fresh-agent recovery of objective, settled decisions, achieved output, verified state and next action as the harness's acceptance boundary, and make a handoff an authored Intent artifact that carries context without carrying authority.
candidates.why: It is the product promise every other continuity decision implements, it selects an observable acceptance test over a structural one, and it will be questioned again every time a control file is added.

candidates.title: Proof, independent judgment and owner authorization are three different facts
candidates.question: When may one of a passing check, a favourable review, and an owner instruction stand in for another?
candidates.existing: Generalises ADR-0023 (tools vs agents), ADR-0037 (independent review) and ADR-0027 (authority order) into the rule none of them states.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR. A green check proves structure, a review supplies judgment, an owner command supplies authority; none substitutes for another, and no child operation widens its parent's grant.
candidates.why: The conflation is the single most repeated failure in the recovered history, and the separation constrains every future gate, skill and report.

candidates.title: The harness is judged by agent outcomes against held-out baselines
candidates.question: What evidence is allowed to support a claim that the Workbench improves an agent's work?
candidates.existing: No existing ADR. AGENTS.md forbids weakening criteria; ADR-0038 rejects artificial pilots. evals/ and outcomes/ run with no decision record.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR. Outcome comparison against a no-harness baseline, condition-blind grading, held-out tasks, grading resulting state including honest incompleteness, and a standing ban on relaxing the rubric or reading a static score as an outcome claim.
candidates.why: It governs the entire evaluation lane, selects against the cheaper self-scoring alternative, and is the decision most likely to be quietly eroded under pressure to show progress.

candidates.title: Feedback carries model provenance, evidence class and durable finding identity
candidates.question: What must a harness feedback record state before its findings can be compared across releases, rooms and models?
candidates.existing: Amends workbench/feedback/REPORT_FORMAT.md, which already scopes finding IDs and skill-copy provenance. Ports AU-0001/0002/0003/0004 reasoning upstream.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR plus a REPORT_FORMAT amendment. Require the evaluated model recorded separately from the reporting model, the three evidence classes kept unpooled, and named execution/evidence failure states so a failed measurement is never read as a failed harness.
candidates.why: Cross-release comparison is impossible without it, and the missing evaluated-model field is a verified gap in the current format.

candidates.title: Skills compose as primitives; invocation, composition and authority are separate axes
candidates.question: How may skills call each other, and what does a composed call inherit?
candidates.existing: Extends ADR-0036 (stances change method not authority) to the whole skill surface. Depends on CAND-F for the bundle's boundary.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR. Primitives stay agnostic to their first caller; a parent may reach a child within its own already-authorized scope; a new effect, destination or consequential decision needs its own resolution; and callability is proved at the host boundary rather than asserted in prose.
candidates.why: The bundle is a closed 17 skills that will keep growing, and every composition question so far has been answered ad hoc.

candidates.title: Where the portable core bundle ends and the personal skills home begins
candidates.question: Does the Workbench ship promote/save/handoff and the lifecycle skills, or do they stay in KaydenClark/skills outside every room?
candidates.existing: Contradicts nothing formally, but S-048 calls save 'unimplemented' while a working save and promote exist in ~/.claude/skills.
candidates.recommendation: OWNER DECISION REQUIRED - see the adjudication queue.
candidates.why: It decides what a fresh room can actually do, and several upstream specs already reason about skills the bundle does not contain.

candidates.title: Genesis, adoption and upgrade are distinct operations over validated sources
candidates.question: What does each setup operation promise to preserve, and what must it check before it mutates anything?
candidates.existing: Extends ADR-0031 and ADR-0032. S-032, S-042, S-044 and S-045 TK-001 implement or contest parts of it with no ADR.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR. Three named operations with different preservation contracts, a preflight over every consumed source lane before mutation, non-destructive classification that reports all gaps at once, and effect-specific limits so a presence-only route never acquires replacement powers.
candidates.why: Four completed specs and one live blocked ticket all orbit this decision, which is a strong sign it is architectural rather than incidental.

candidates.title: Provenance is layered: release, adoption, installed generation, present bytes, running runtime
candidates.question: When someone says 'the room is on v3.1.3', which of five different facts is being claimed?
candidates.existing: Extends ADR-0031's receipt model; ports AU-0004 upstream. S-031, S-039 and S-042 implement layers of it.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR. Name the five states, require each claim to say which one it asserts, keep historical adoption provenance separate from current component provenance, and keep unknown generation visible rather than assumed current.
candidates.why: This room's own doctor output currently shows two of these layers disagreeing, and the distinction decides what a bug report is even about.

candidates.title: Delivery is proven by the exact ref and object, not by local state
candidates.question: What proves that work is recoverable, integrated and complete?
candidates.existing: Extends ADR-0037 (exact-candidate review) and ADR-0039. AGENTS.md already states the containment rule without its rationale.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR. Prove remote containment by reading the intended ref for the exact object; treat missing tracking metadata as unknown rather than unpushed; preserve dirty work before cleanup; and report authored, reviewed, delivered, installed and accepted as separate facts.
candidates.why: The recovered record contains repeated false unsaved-work alarms and repeated premature completion claims; both are consequences of the same missing rule.

candidates.title: An unavailable baseline is a third state, recorded with evidence
candidates.question: What does a harness-only change do when the target has no runnable green baseline for reasons the change cannot fix?
candidates.existing: Links ADR-0020 (a check blocks only what it evaluates). S-041 is complete and records the owner's explicit choice.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR. Record-and-proceed with declared reasons and evidence, narrowly scoped; a failing baseline stays failing and unavailable may never relabel red as green.
candidates.why: It is an explicit owner ruling that currently survives only inside a completed spec, and it will be reached again in every room with a host or product constraint.

candidates.title: Control fidelity: filling a placeholder preserves the surrounding rule
candidates.question: How much may a room's controls diverge from the template they derive from before that divergence must be decided rather than discovered?
candidates.existing: No existing ADR. S-034 (fidelity report) and S-036 (permission model correction) are both complete; Example_Workbench is the live reference.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR. A placeholder fill preserves authority, privacy and verification wording; a changed or dropped rule is exposed and either restored or recorded as a decision; a pinned example plus matching template revision is the comparison reference and a similarity report authorizes nothing.
candidates.why: A Forbidden-to-Allowed reversal once passed as an expected placeholder fill, which is exactly the class of silent failure an ADR should foreclose.

candidates.title: Record syntax is portable; reading never rewrites
candidates.question: Does a record's meaning depend on the host that checked it out?
candidates.existing: No existing ADR. S-037 is complete with tests covering LF, CRLF and CR frontmatter.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR, small. Frontmatter parses equivalently across line terminators, validation is read-only, and an editing operation preserves the room's terminator.
candidates.why: It binds every future record parser and validator, and the failure it prevents made an entire Windows room report every record broken.

candidates.title: One durable writer per shared surface
candidates.question: What makes parallel agent work safe, and what does 'different task' fail to guarantee?
candidates.existing: AGENTS.md carries a one-line rule for spec/Taskboard state; no ADR gives it scope or rationale.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR. Independent reads may run in parallel; every write to a shared repository, spec, register or installed product needs non-overlapping ownership or serialization, proved by the actual write surface rather than by task names.
candidates.why: The rule already exists but only for two artifacts; parallel agent use is growing and the general form will otherwise be re-derived per incident.

candidates.title: How continuity crosses machines
candidates.question: Notes are local-only and gitignored, but the owner works on two machines. What carries objective continuity across them?
candidates.existing: ADR-0040 selects JSON and local-only and deliberately leaves transport unselected; ADR-0028 makes tracked checkpoints the only current crossing.
candidates.recommendation: OWNER DECISION REQUIRED - see the adjudication queue.
candidates.why: Local persistence and cross-host recoverability are different guarantees, and the gap is currently invisible because nothing claims to close it.

candidates.title: The implementation language of the portable runtime
candidates.question: Node stays, or the runtime migrates to Python.
candidates.existing: No ADR. All portable runtime tooling is Node .mjs; only the evals lane is Python.
candidates.recommendation: OWNER DECISION REQUIRED - see the adjudication queue.
candidates.why: It is the largest unrecorded architectural fact in the repository and the owner stated a contrary preference that was never adjudicated.

candidates.title: The provider enforcement floor
candidates.question: What must a host provide before the Workbench claims to work on it, and does the harness ship provider-native enforcement or stay prose plus tools?
candidates.existing: ADR-0005 requires a running consumer but names none for provider behavior; skillPolicy.discovery is the only provider-aware declaration.
candidates.recommendation: OWNER DECISION REQUIRED - see the adjudication queue.
candidates.why: It decides whether portability means identical instructions or identical guarantees, which changes what every conformance test can assert.

candidates.title: The durable promotion boundary after checkpoints
candidates.question: If checkpoints retire, what becomes the privacy-checked crossing from local working record to durable evidence?
candidates.existing: ADR-0028 makes checkpoints that crossing; S-048 (planned) proposes retiring them; ADR-0040 points at reconciliation into owners instead.
candidates.recommendation: OWNER DECISION REQUIRED - see the adjudication queue.
candidates.why: ADR-0028 is currently load-bearing for every durable citation into a session record, so retiring its target is a foundational change.

candidates.title: Extension architecture is retained as lineage, not revived
candidates.question: What happens to the Foundry, Flight, CAS, Lighthouse and CIC designs now that the Workbench is standalone?
candidates.existing: Executes ADR-0015 and ADR-0026. Collapses 35 recovered items plus the superseded producer topology into one decision and one archive article.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR plus one wiki/archive Design Concept article. Record the extension corpus as dated lineage with its corrections attached, state that no base behavior may depend on it, and forbid reinstating any of it as an upstream requirement without a new decision.
candidates.why: Without one explicit parking decision these 35 records will be re-litigated individually, and several of them contradict current architecture if read as live.

candidates.title: An open follow-up needs a reachable current owner
candidates.question: Where does an acknowledged-but-unfinished finding live so the entry route still reaches it?
candidates.existing: Extends ADR-0035 (entry) and ADR-0042 (traversal). S-045 exists because seven follow-ups survived only as prose inside completed specs.
candidates.recommendation: New ADR, small. An open finding needs a current owner with truthful ready/blocked state reachable from ordinary entry; a completed spec cannot be its only home; and this creates no authority to invent or dispatch work.
candidates.why: It is the invariant behind a live spec, it constrains where completion evidence may hide, and it was violated seven times before anyone noticed.

amendments.title: Add the inter-room interface and the public/private packaging boundary
amendments.why: ADR-0026 names LLM_Workbench the sole source but not the deployer and auditor roles that GPT_OS and Audit_Workbench actually play, nor the rule that a public product excludes private instance state.

amendments.title: Name target movement as a trigger for fresh review
amendments.why: ADR-0037 says a changed candidate needs fresh review; it does not say that a moved integration target producing a different merge result is such a change.

amendments.title: Preserve question identity across notepad merges
amendments.why: ADR-0040 requires preserving sources, uncertainty and corrections but not stable question identities, which is how earlier recovery attempts lost dozens of settled answers.
